Question 13
?

Find and categorize all local the extrema of the function f(x,y)=ex2+y2, and determine which of the following statements is true.

a
f(x,y) has a saddle point at (0,0)
b
f(x,y) has a local minimum at (0,0)
c
f(x,y) has a local maximum at (0,0)
d
f(x,y) has a local minimum at (1,−1)
e
f(x,y) has a local maximum at (1,−1)
